name: Kaushalya Logistics Ltd
about: Founded in August 2007, Kaushalya Logistics Limited provides clearing and forwarding services to a leading cement company in India. [1]
keyPoints:
Logistics Business Division[1][2]
a) Logistics & Transportation - The company provides customized services to cement companies including multimodal transportation, pick-up, packing, delivery, distribution, and full documentation.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.19 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 44.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 24.5%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.22.3 Cr.
